authority_scope: repository-local verifier behavior and conformance evidence; not CAWG/C2PA/TRQP normative authority

vectors.proposition: An otherwise valid actor cannot exercise authority outside the delegated action/resource scope.
vectors.mutation: substitute requested action or resource outside delegated scope while retaining actor identity and provenance

vectors.proposition: A valid content/provenance signal cannot survive substitution onto an unattested governed gateway route.
vectors.mutation: replace the governed gateway route while preserving otherwise valid evidence

vectors.proposition: Recognition evidence cannot authorize an issuer whose current authority state is revoked.
vectors.mutation: present previously recognized issuer evidence after revocation

vectors.proposition: Removing a mandatory provenance assertion cannot preserve a trusted result.
vectors.mutation: remove one mandatory provenance assertion while retaining signature-valid remaining assertions

vectors.proposition: Replay evidence rooted in a different trusted-root context cannot be accepted as evidence for the current decision.
vectors.mutation: replay a valid bundle under a non-matching trusted root
